Found 18 items in registries @onchain-ui:

Showing items 1-18 of 18:

- address-display (registry:ui) - Displays an EVM wallet address with copy-to-clipboard and an optional block explorer link. [@onchain-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- address-identity (registry:ui) - Resolves an EVM address to an ENS or Base name with optional avatar, copy-to-clipboard, and explorer link. [@onchain-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- amount-input (registry:ui) - Controlled decimal string input for token amounts. Preserves precision and incomplete edits, with an optional fractional digit limit. [@onchain-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- asset-input (registry:ui) - Labeled amount field for swaps, sells, and deposits, with slots for token selection, supporting text, balances, and actions. No wallet provider required. [@onchain-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- asset-row (registry:ui) - Displays a practical portfolio or watchlist row from token identity, network, amount, value, and change. [@onchain-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- chain-select (registry:ui) - Network selector for wallet switching or filtering, with optional all-networks and unsupported-chain states. [@onchain-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- connect-wallet (registry:block) - A complete connect, identity, and disconnect surface wired to wagmi. [@onchain-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- connector-list (registry:ui) - A wallet picker list with icons, pending state, and a no-wallet-detected fallback. [@onchain-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- crypto-icons (registry:lib) - Swappable adapter that resolves token and network icons for onchain-ui components. [@onchain-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- network-logo (registry:ui) - Displays a network or chain logo with known chain fallbacks. [@onchain-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- onchain-config (registry:lib) - One file for app-wide chain settings: explorers, network names, read clients, and avatar gateways. [@onchain-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- sonner (registry:ui) - Toast notifications themed by your app's CSS tokens. A framework-agnostic Toaster with no next-themes dependency. [@onchain-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- token-balance (registry:ui) - Displays a token amount with optional logo, fiat value, and change. [@onchain-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- token-logo (registry:ui) - Displays a token image with resilient symbol, name, or address fallback. [@onchain-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- token-price (registry:ui) - Formats token prices with optional positive, negative, or neutral change. [@onchain-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- token-stack (registry:ui) - Displays overlapping token logos for baskets, pools, routes, and portfolio rows. [@onchain-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-available-connectors (registry:hook) - Filters unavailable injected wallets while preserving mobile and remote wagmi connectors. [@onchain-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- wallet-button (registry:ui) - The connected-wallet pill: resolved identity, network mark, and a disclosure chevron. [@onchain-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`
